description: Solar flare and radiation storm picture: discrete flare events from the past week with peak class and R-scale level, recent GOES X-ray flux with flare-class labels (A/B/C/M/X) and class magnitude, the daily F10.7 cm solar radio flux, 3-day flare-class probabilities (C/M/X), active solar regions with per-region flare probabilities, and GOES integral proton flux at ≥10 MeV with NOAA S-scale. For operators tracking HF radio blackout (R-scale, driven by X-ray) and radiation storm risk (S-scale, driven by protons). Each active region carries the C/M/X flare counts SWPC attributed to it that UTC day, which identify the region driving current activity — the flare events themselves carry no region.

flare_hours.description: How far back to report discrete flare events, in hours before now, filtered on each flare’s onset time (1–168, default 24). The feed keeps a rolling 7 days, so 168 returns everything it carries. When the window comes back empty, the response names the newest flare the feed holds.

include_regions.description: Include active solar region details (default true). Set false to skip region data and reduce response size.

name: noaa_spaceweather_get_solar_activity

activeRegions.description: Active regions; empty when include_regions=false or none are active.

areaMillionths.description: Sunspot area in millionths of the hemisphere; null for a spotless region.

cFlareCount.description: C-class flares SWPC credited to this region on observedDate.

cFlareProbability.description: C-class flare chance (%) for the UTC day after observedDate.

firstObserved.description: ISO 8601 UTC time SWPC first recorded this region.

mFlareCount.description: M-class flares SWPC credited to this region on observedDate.

mFlareProbability.description: M-class flare chance (%) for the UTC day after observedDate.

magClass.description: Magnetic class, e.g. "B"; empty for a spotless region.

numberSpots.description: Sunspot count; 0 for a spotless region.

observedDate.description: UTC observation date: the flare counts cover it, the probabilities the next day.

protonProbability.description: Proton event chance (%) for the UTC day after observedDate.

spotClass.description: Sunspot class, e.g. "Dsi"; empty for a spotless region (plage).

xFlareCount.description: X-class flares SWPC credited to this region on observedDate.

xFlareProbability.description: X-class flare chance (%) for the UTC day after observedDate.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `feed_unavailable`: SWPC feed returns 5xx or 429, times out, or answers with a body that is not parseable JSON. Retried for up to 45 seconds in total before failing. `feed_moved`: SWPC feed path returns a permanent 4xx (404, 410, 401, 403). Fails in one attempt. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

fluxSfu.description: 10.7 cm (2800 MHz) solar radio flux, in sfu.

ninetyDayMeanSfu.description: 90-day mean flux in sfu; null when the record carries none.

observedTime.description: ISO 8601 UTC observation time; can be ~24 h old.

f107.description: Latest Noon report, SWPC's daily F10.7 value; null when the feed has none.

fluxPfu.description: ≥10 MeV integral proton flux in pfu, to 3 significant figures.

latestProton.description: Newest ≥10 MeV proton reading; null when the feed is empty.

flareClass.description: Flare class letter: A, B, C, M, or X.

flareClassFull.description: Class with magnitude, e.g. "B2.5"; null below A1 (1e-8 W/m²), zero and negative readings included.

fluxWm2.description: Long-channel (0.1–0.8 nm) X-ray flux for display, e.g. "1.4e-6 W/m²".

fluxWm2Value.description: fluxWm2 as an unformatted number, in W/m².

latestXray.description: Newest X-ray reading; null when the feed is empty.

notice.description: Set when no flare began in the flare_hours window: names the newest flare in the feed, or says the feed has none.

cClassProbability.description: C-class flare chance (%) for this date.

mClassProbability.description: M-class flare chance (%) for this date.

protonEventProbability.description: ≥10 MeV proton event chance (%) for this date.

xClassProbability.description: X-class flare chance (%) for this date.

recentFlares.description: Flares with onset inside flare_hours, oldest first; empty when none began.

endClass.description: Class at decay; null while in progress.

endTime.description: ISO 8601 UTC decay time; null while in progress.

maxClass.description: Peak class as SWPC publishes it, e.g. "M5.2"; null when SWPC recorded no peak.

maxTime.description: ISO 8601 UTC peak time; null when SWPC recorded no peak.

peakFluxWm2.description: Peak long-channel (0.1–0.8 nm) flux, in W/m²; null when SWPC recorded no peak.

rScale.description: R level (0–5) the peak flux implies; 0 is below R1, null with no recorded peak.

recentXray.description: X-ray readings from the past hour, oldest first.

flareClass.description: Flare class letter: A, B, C, M, or X.

flareClassFull.description: Class with magnitude, e.g. "B2.5"; null below A1 (1e-8 W/m²), zero and negative readings included.

fluxWm2.description: Long-channel (0.1–0.8 nm) X-ray flux for display, e.g. "1.4e-6 W/m²".

fluxWm2Value.description: fluxWm2 as an unformatted number, in W/m².

sScale.description: Current S level (0–5) from latestProton; 0 without a reading.

sScaleText.description: S level descriptor, e.g. "S2 moderate radiation storm".

title: Get Solar Activity
